scripts.infra:up: $(command -v docker >/dev/null && echo docker || echo podman) compose -f apps/api/docker-compose.yaml up -d --wait
scripts.infra:down: $(command -v docker >/dev/null && echo docker || echo podman) compose -f apps/api/docker-compose.yaml down
scripts.ready: vp check && vp run -r typecheck && vp run -r build
